sandbox_degraded.title: lotse runs with a weakened sandbox
sandbox_degraded.description:
lotse reads camera streams from the network, so each of its processes is hardened in layers. The running lotse lacks these layers: {layers}.

Start lotse as root so it can drop its privileges itself, on a kernel with seccomp and Landlock enabled. Home Assistant checks again on every connection to lotse and removes this message once the layers are in place.

sandbox_off.title: lotse runs without its sandbox
sandbox_off.description:
lotse was started with its sandbox off, so its processes run without the hardening that limits what a compromised camera stream could do.

Start lotse with its sandbox on, the default: without `--sandbox off` or `LOTSE_SANDBOX=off`. Home Assistant checks again on every connection to lotse and removes this message once the sandbox is on.
